question: How do I complete the synthetic Blue Lantern permit replacement exercise?

required_explanation_claims.claim: The exercise applies only to a placard marked TEST ONLY with a blue-lantern symbol.
The exercise is complete only after all five steps are finished.

ordered_steps.summary: Verify the TEST ONLY words and blue-lantern symbol.
Record fixture code BL-204 and open the PDF.
Enter Fixture Student and BL-204 in the synthetic form.
Attach the sample image labeled BLUE-LANTERN-SAMPLE.
Submit through the fixture-only route and retain confirmation TEST-COMPLETE.

prohibited_claims: This is a real PNW parking procedure.
A real student account was checked.
A real permit or transaction was changed.
